page_title: NAP 3-0 EMP | Napoli v Empoli 14/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
90+2' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.

89' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Fabbri with no other option than to blow for a foul.
87' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
86' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who makes a comfortable save.
82' Substitution. Liam Henderson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Philip Billing (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Billy Gilmour can be given a rest.
82' Substitution. Romelu Lukaku makes his way off the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
82' That will be all from Matteo Politano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
82' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Liberato Cacace is replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).
81' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
80' The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
78' The ball has crossed the sideline. Napoli are taking a throw-in.

76' What a huge chance for Romelu Lukaku (Napoli). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
76' It looks like Alberto Grassi (Empoli) saw red with that tackle. Michael Fabbri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
75' Substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi walks off the pitch and Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
72' Substitution. Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) in, Mattia Viti out.
72' Antonio Conte is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Juan Jesus suffers an injury and Rafa Marin (Napoli) comes on.
72' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
70' Juan Jesus (Napoli) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
70' Empoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Empoli.
68' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
67' Scott McTominay (Napoli) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!
66' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Empoli will take a throw-in.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.

61' 3 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku hands Scott McTominay (Napoli) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the top right corner. 3:0.
60' Jacopo Fazzini will be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
59' Liam Henderson (Empoli) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
59' He should have scored! Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
56' 2 - 0 Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.

54' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.

52' Scott McTominay (Napoli) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
51' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
50' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a throw-in.
47' Juan Jesus (Napoli) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
47' Corner kick. Billy Gilmour (Napoli) is ready to send the ball into the box.
46' A cross from David Neres (Napoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Napoli will take a corner kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for an infringement.
44' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
42' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
40' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner kick, but Alex Meret reads it well and stops the effort.

40' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the left side of the goal, but Alex Meret has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Empoli are going to take it.
38' That was close by Billy Gilmour (Napoli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
38' An attempted cross from Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is cleared.
37' The cross into the penalty area from David Neres (Napoli) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
35' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Romelu Lukaku (Napoli).
33' Liam Henderson (Empoli) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alex Meret.
33' The ball is behind the touchline and Empoli will take a throw-in.
32' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) leaps to collect the ball.
32' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Napoli earn a corner.
32' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

31' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
30' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Billy Gilmour (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play. Empoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' CHANCE! David Neres (Napoli) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, but the goalkeeper stands tall and produces an excellent save. Napoli win a corner.
25' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Fabbri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' A crossfield pass from Mattia Viti (Empoli) fails to find any of his teammates.
21' Matteo Politano (Napoli) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
20' A lofted pass finds Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku tees up Scott McTominay (Napoli) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
16' Scott McTominay (Napoli) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach.
16' The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
15' A lofted pass into the box is met by Romelu Lukaku (Napoli), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
14' Mattia Viti (Empoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Napoli earn a free kick.
12' Scott McTominay (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of David Neres, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
11' Michael Fabbri blows for a foul after Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
8' It's a throw-in for Empoli.
7' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Meret (Napoli).
7' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Empoli have a corner.
7' Empoli take a short corner kick.
5' David Neres (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

3' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Empoli.
3' The linesman signals a throw-in for Napoli.

1' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will officiate today.
